answer: SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934;
SELECT c.id, c.artist FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL) AND l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal';
SELECT DISTINCT s.isForeignOnly FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(isTextless) AS proportion FROM cards;
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic' AND l.format = 'gladiator' AND l.status = 'Banned';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' AND subtypes <> 'Angel';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(id) AS pct FROM foreign_data;

WITH top_format AS (SELECT format FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT l.format, c.name FROM legalities l JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned' AND l.format = (SELECT format FROM top_format);
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct FROM cards c JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*';
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count FROM cards c JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid GROUP BY c.uuid ORDER BY ruling_count DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS set_name, st.translation AS italian_name FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE c.name = "Ancestor's Chosen" AND st.language = 'Italian';
